_comment: prd.md §13.4. Generated from worker/demosaic_worker/policies.py and asserted from both sides. Covers the measured window table (D-16) and the router's closed reason enum. confidenceGateCases.description: a fresh track is withheld before anything is known
a confident track opens after the hysteresis window
exactly at the threshold opens the gate
chattering never gets three consecutive frames, so it never opens
open then a sustained fall re-closes it
a negative threshold is also disabled
a gate above every confidence withholds forever
a dip that stays within the margin does not re-close it

confidenceGateInterleaved.description: two tracks fed alternately; gate state is per track

confidenceSmootherCases.description: the first frame passes through unchanged
a steady signal converges towards it
a single dip is damped, not followed
a sustained fall is followed, just slowly
a window of one is no smoothing at all

confidenceSmootherInterleaved.description: two tracks fed alternately; smoother state is per track
